title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Acceptance of Cases for Recognition of Divorce Judgments Rendered by Foreign Courts by People's Courts

articles.content_en: I. When a Chinese citizen applies to a People's Court for recognition of a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court, the People's Court shall not refuse to accept the case on the ground that the marital relationship was not established in China; when a Chinese citizen applies for recognition of a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court in absentia, the citizen shall simultaneously submit to the People's Court relevant supporting documents proving that the foreign court which rendered the judgment had lawfully summoned him or her to appear in court.

II. When a foreign citizen applies to a People's Court for recognition of a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court, if the former spouse in the divorce is a Chinese citizen, the People's Court shall accept the case; if the former spouse in the divorce is a foreign citizen, the People's Court shall not accept the case, but may inform the applicant to directly apply to the marriage registration authority for re-marriage registration.

III. Where a party applies to a People's Court for recognition of the validity of a divorce mediation statement rendered by a foreign court, the People's Court shall accept the case and shall conduct examination in accordance with the Provisions on the Procedure for Chinese Citizens Applying for Recognition of Divorce Judgments Rendered by Foreign Courts, and shall render a ruling on recognition or non-recognition.
As of the date of promulgation of these Provisions, the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Acceptance by People's Courts of Cases for Recognition of Divorce Judgments Rendered by Foreign Courts, issued by this Court under the Notice Fa [1998] No. 86, shall be simultaneously abolished.
